title: Quark WMS Receiving Demo | Warehouse Receiving with Web & RF
problem: Record incoming goods and hand received stock to the next warehouse operation.
stages: View the inbound receipt in the web interface.
Follow the receiving workflow on an RF terminal.
accessibleDescription: The recording shows receiving in the Quark web interface and on an RF terminal. The web view provides the inbound receipt context; the RF view shows the warehouse receiving workflow.

title: Quark WMS Putaway Demo | RF Warehouse Operations
problem: Move received stock into its storage location with an RF workflow.
stages: Follow the putaway workflow in the RF interface.
accessibleDescription: The recording shows a warehouse operator working through putaway in the Quark RF interface. Putaway moves received goods into storage and records the destination in the warehouse workflow.

title: Quark WMS Inventory Counting Demo | RF Stock Counting
problem: Record warehouse count observations for inventory review.
stages: Follow inventory counting in the RF interface.
accessibleDescription: The recording follows inventory counting on a Quark RF terminal. Warehouse staff use the RF workflow to record count observations for inventory review.

title: Quark WMS Replenishment Demo | Web & RF Warehouse Workflow
problem: Keep picking locations supplied through replenishment planning and RF execution.
stages: View replenishment in the web interface.
Follow replenishment execution on an RF terminal.
accessibleDescription: The recording shows replenishment management in the Quark web application and execution on an RF terminal. These views connect the office planning context with the warehouse replenishment workflow.
